title: 基石资产管理（香港）梁：市场已看2027年盈利，远期预测高度不确定，波动
speaker: Michael Liang

segments.en: Okay does that mean rotation then? I mean how are you looking at the rest of the second half now?
segments.zh: 那是否意味着轮动？你对下半年怎么看？

segments.en: I would love to be a very bullish on it but I think it's at the best you see some rotation like you said but overall market trend probably going to be the just you know with volatility up and down.
segments.zh: 我很想乐观，但最多像你说的有些轮动，整体市场趋势可能只是上下波动。

segments.en: But you know the market is not really trading at 2026 PE anymore they're looking at 2027 and beyond.
segments.zh: 但市场已经不再看2026年市盈率，而是看2027年及以后。

segments.en: When you look at that far out it's very difficult to be certain right given was you know things of changing very fast.
segments.zh: 看得那么远很难确定，因为变化很快。

segments.en: So on that very bullish view 2027 2028 earnings PE probably okay but there's a high degree of certainty associated with that forecast.
segments.zh: 所以非常乐观的观点认为2027、2028年盈利市盈率可能还行，但那个预测的确定性很高。

segments.en: So I think Marco continue to win that adjustment looking to the future that's why there's a kind of be volatility with us.
segments.zh: 所以我认为宏观将继续主导调整，看向未来，这就是为什么波动会伴随我们。

segments.en: Yeah Michael can you talk a bit more about that to the future right because some of these memory names their capex plans as we speak in South Korea they are what two three four years from now.
segments.zh: 能再谈谈未来吗？因为一些存储公司的资本开支计划，在韩国，是两三年甚至四年后。
